Resolves #19792

This is the data contract under epic #19791's record search. It adds `Neo.collection.SearchFilter`, a Store-wide search in which every whitespace term must occur in at least one declared field, together with the seams it needs: a columnless owner slot, Filter subclasses in Collection configs, and a declared read set for counting and soft hydration. Nothing visual ships here; the toolbar and header leaves consume it.

Evidence: L2 (unit specs on real Stores and Collections, an acceptance fixture computed independently by Emmy, two mutations that turn the specs red) → L2 required (AC-1–AC-6).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `StoreSearch.spec.mjs`, "an explicit null property stays the columnless slot…": a re-sent identical config keeps the live instance, and a changed one replaces it within the same slot. "duplicate owned contributions are refused…": two searches, or a search plus a `property: null` callback, refuse with `grid-search/null`, and the Store keeps its filters. An omitted-property callback still keys `app/id`. "coexists with per-field roles…" covers the rest. |
| AC-2 | "the acceptance fixture…": Emmy's five records and expected ids, verbatim, covering terms, case, title-only scope, the application restriction and the composed predicates |
| AC-3 | "an empty or whitespace query is inert…": all five records stay, `effective` is false, the fields are kept, and `'queue'` filters again. `disabled` is independent. |
| AC-4 | The fixture's picker counts are `grid: 1, Store: 1`. "raw-item counts under a search…": on raw items the counts are `grid: 2, Store: 2`, and a non-canonical searched value refuses with `noncanonical-field` |
| AC-5 | "getSearchRefusal names what a Store cannot search" (unknown field, Date, Array, Date with a hook, remote, TreeStore), plus "a fieldText hook makes a Date searchable…" |
| AC-6 | "soft hydration resolves declared fields and never writes a null key on raw items" (a calculated `name` field on `autoInitRecords: false`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- The search is a generic `Filter` subclass in `src/collection/`. It is neither a grid-side owner nor a `filterBy` callback: overriding `isFiltered` and `export()` leaves no callback to swap and needs no Grid import (API shape posted beforehand, comment 6213003977). The ticket body is updated to match.
- An empty query is inert and not `effective`; it does not toggle `disabled`. The outcome matches the graduated contract with one state fewer, and Emmy was told.
- `getSearchRefusal` lives on the Store, because refusals need population knowledge (remote state, trees) that a Filter doesn't have.
- The grid-level lifecycle witnesses (Store swap, grid recreate, two grids on one Store) moved to #19794, where a grid exists. Its body is updated.
- Found during the work: Neo's processed config carries a base `module` entry, so reconciliation skips `module` as a runtime config and compares the constructor instead. Without that, a subclass could never be reused.
- From Euclid's seam read (issuecomment-6213122254), in `e100abcc50`:
  - Instance keys reconcile by identity alone, so `filters.slice()` keeps a SearchFilter and its subscriptions.
  - A `module` outside the Filter family is refused inside the existing rollback path. The check is `Filter.isPrototypeOf(module)`, because Neo's `instanceof` only answers for instances.
  - An explicit `property: undefined` is absent: validation and construction both take the class default.
  - The regenerated `docs/output/class-hierarchy.json` adds the new class (`check-freshness`).
- From Emmy's consumer probe, in `2da4a1f440`: an empty `fields` list is inert like an empty query. It keeps every record and is not `effective`, as #19786 contract 4 requires; the query and `disabled` stay independent. Before this, `fields: []` with a query hid every record.
- From Euclid's exact-head packet, in `91cc4d3201`:
  - A Filter instance joins a collection once, and only while it is live and unattached or already this collection's. A destroyed instance, a repeated instance, or one attached to another collection is refused before any effect. A fresh standalone instance is still adopted. This closes a hole that `e100abcc50`'s adoption path had opened: a shared filter missed one owner's change events, and clearing one owner destroyed it for the other.
  - `fieldText` hooks are read only as own functions (`SearchFilter.getHook`), in matching and in `getSearchRefusal` alike, so a field named `toString` never calls `Object.prototype.toString`.

## Test Evidence
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/data/StoreSearch.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/data/StoreFilterValues.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/collection test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs`: 127 passed at `e100abcc50`, including "instances keep identity, base and subclass never reconcile, and a foreign module is refused", which covers Euclid's decisive controls.
- `StoreSearch.spec.mjs` at `2da4a1f440`: 12 passed. The new empty-scope test fails against the previous `SearchFilter`.
- At `91cc4d3201`: the focused set passes 130. "a Filter instance joins one collection once…" and "fieldText hooks are own functions…" both fail against the `2da4a1f440` sources.
- Mutation 1: with `src/collection/Base.mjs` reverted to `dev`, 7 of 9 search tests fail (the two unaffected ones don't touch Collection).
- Mutation 2: with the old `getFilterValues` read set, the raw-item counts test fails. The first version of the spec missed this, because the canonical check only runs on raw items; the raw-item test closes that gap.
- `npm run test-unit` (full, at `91cc4d3201`): 5,224 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed. The failure, `unit/e2e/glState.spec.mjs:124`, fails identically on a `dev` worktree: the repo's copy of Playwright's disabled features versus my local Playwright install.
- `npm run test-e2e` with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`, on HeaderInlineProjection, HeaderMenuCoverage/Interaction/State and IssuesShowcase: 27 passed.
